verdicts.reason: A keeps a sensible order (headline, subcopy, controller, CTA), but the CTA is centred while the text is left-aligned, the Fizzbang can that was a hero item is shrunk to a tiny icon next to an undersized logo, and there is dead space below the CTA. B puts the CTA above the headline, so the reading order is backwards. Its button is also off the headline's left edge (it starts further right), there is a large unexplained gap between the headline and subcopy, and the can is again a tiny afterthought at the bottom left.
